config.question: Does the owner's descending-trendline break become a profitable long strategy once a take-profit and stop-loss are searched, and does any searched cell survive an out-of-selection time segment?
config.single_variable: The exit only. Entry, indicator parameters, universe, costs and execution assumptions are frozen; the searched axis is (stop_loss_atr, take_profit_atr).
config.source_note: OKX USDT perpetual 15m CSVs already in the repository. All rows are parsed by the frozen release_eth_prefix byte-gated reader, which stops at the first row at or after the holdout boundary.
config.instrument_note: read_prefix stamps its receipt with instrument ETH-USDT-SWAP because it was written for that one file. The symbol is taken from the filename here and the receipt field is ignored.
config.leverage_note: median entry price / R. A cell above the cap is excluded from selection: risking 1% of equity there needs more than 10x notional, and the net-R axis rewards tight stops purely because a fixed percentage fee is smaller when measured in a smaller R.
config.selection_rule: Among development cells with at least min_signals_for_selection signals and median notional per R at or below max_notional_per_r, take the cell whose median of (own mean net R, up to four grid-neighbour mean net R) is highest. Ties go to the smaller stop, then the smaller target.
reported_metrics: mean net return in bp of notional (unit-free)
config.cost_note: 0.2% round trip, the project's frozen assumption. Funding and slippage are not modelled; both would make the result worse.
config.side: long only, on the upward close-confirmed break of the descending line
config.entry: next bar open after the break bar's close
config.risk_unit: R = stop_loss_atr x ATR(14) at the signal bar
config.control_note: Same symbol, same UTC month of the signal's close, same causal volatility tercile (SMA14 true range / close versus its own preceding 120 values). Same barriers, same horizon, same cost.
pass_criteria_review: mean net R per signal on the review segment is positive
matched paired excess net R on the review segment is positive
month-block sign-flip one-sided p < 0.01 on the review segment
config.pass_note: All three are required. Passing means only that it is worth asking the owner for a holdout read; it is not a promotion, not a live permission, and not a trade.
